info.name: DalCor Pharmaceuticals Content API (WordPress REST API) Search API

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure the result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit the result set to specific IDs.

params.name: wpml_language
params.description: WPML language code. The site publishes an English and a French edition; `en` returns 24 posts / 17 pages and `fr` returns 6 posts / 15 pages (observed 2026-08-04).

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

items.docs: Cross-content search returning lightweight {id, title, url, type, subtype} records. Available subtypes on this site are post, page, e-floating-buttons, elementor_library, category and post_tag.
